agent_answer:
**B. Marcus**

Marcus’s response — “yeah I’ll skip the walk. More time to set up the grill.” — signals that his actual preference was for the **home-cooked/grill plan**, not an outing. The tell is that he chose to **skip the walk** specifically to have **more time to set up the grill**, showing his priority was the at-home Saturday meal and his role in it. Tanya’s follow-up (“grill goes on by noon”) reinforces that the group plan centered on cooking at home.
